decision: Pin Arc and preserve the complete Web and native product scope
why: The user selected a single library for both platforms; the upstream provides DOM components, so native controls need explicit ports

decision: Generate Web CSS and native colors and geometry from the same pinned Arc files
why: Mobile cannot execute DOM components; generated native values prevent a second palette and size system

decision: Add a source and route guard and include Arc sources in build fingerprints and CI scope
why: New UI must not reuse old components or build stale output after a shared-source change
result: source fingerprint and CI self-tests passed

decision: Fix compiled utility names and line heights instead of relying on source-pattern checks
why: The independent reviewer ran Tailwind and showed missing color classes despite a passing policy guard
result: compiled Web and native class checks passed
